title: PythonModuleAppVar
description: PYMP contains the same metadata record stream as PYCD/PYSC: ULEB128 record lengths include the one-byte type (1 = filename, 2 = menu definitions). A zero-length record ends the stream, followed by compiledDataHex. rawDataHex takes precedence over structured fields; otherwise metadataRecords takes precedence over filename and menuDefinitions fields.

length.description: Length of the type byte plus record data, excluding the ULEB128 length.

filename.description: Filename from the first type 1 record.

metadataRecords.description: Ordered metadata records, preserving duplicates and unknown record types. Per-record rawDataHex takes precedence over name or text.

menuDefinitions.description: Text from the first type 2 record, excluding an optional trailing NUL in its data.

menuDefinitionsLength.description: Menu record data length, excluding the record ID and stream terminator.

menuDefinitionsNullTerminated.description: Whether the menu record data itself ends in NUL. The separate zero-length stream terminator is not part of the menu.
